A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same NSP study and provide readable text, equations, five figures and four tables. All 10 pages of each were inspected; neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original NSP denoising and noisy-image super-resolution results, plus target-construction and scaling ablations in Tables 1–4.

after.justification: v2 retains the original NSP benchmark results, qualitative outputs and ablations in Tables 1–4 and Figures 4–5.

M1.justification: Sections 3.2–3.4 retain the same cross-scale pair construction, BSN pixel-shuffle modification, reconstruction loss, and denoising/super-resolution inference procedures. No algorithmic or architectural component changes.

E1.justification: Both use SIDD Medium for training, SIDD Validation, SIDD Benchmark and DND for denoising evaluation, and downsampled SIDD data for noisy-image super-resolution. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain identical comparator membership, including AP-BSN, SDAP and TBSN for denoising, and the same zero-shot SR methods and SDAP+SR combinations. Figure 4 also retains its comparator set.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 retain the same sample counts, metrics, backbones and training settings, including s=5, t=2, batch size 16 and 750 epochs. The bicubic 2× SR preprocessing and 180×180 SR training patches are unchanged.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 and Tables 3–4 retain the same analyses of four target-construction strategies, target count n and scaling factor t. No ablation, robustness test or case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run variability, seed information, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. The uncertainty-reporting practice is unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4 retain identical numerical results and rankings. For example, NSP(DBSN) remains at 37.02/0.8865 PSNR/SSIM on SIDD Validation. Figures 4–5 contain the same qualitative image outputs.

T1.justification: Equations 1–13, the BSN noise assumptions and the training-pair counting expressions are unchanged. Differences in equation text extraction do not correspond to mathematical changes in the rendered PDFs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same central claims: NSP decouples noise decorrelation from detail preservation, introduces cross-scale training pairs, achieves strong denoising performance and supports noisy-image super-resolution without model modification.

C2.justification: Section 2.1 qualifies 'without sacrificing image fidelity' as 'minimally compromising image fidelity,' and Section 2.2 changes 'fully decorrelated' to 'effectively decorrelated.' Conversely, the introduction strengthens 'may inadvertently learn' noise correlations to 'inevitably learns.' These interpretations change without new empirical evidence.

D1.justification: v2 adds an explicit code-repository link in the abstract, absent from v1. Implementation settings and hardware disclosures remain unchanged. The PDFs establish the added access information, but not the repository's contents or usability.

R1.justification: Both retain the same 44 cited works and the same positioning relative to BSN/PD methods and visual autoregressive modeling. Local edits to prior-work descriptions do not substantively change that positioning.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized introduction and related-work edits, rewrites a Table 2 footnote, updates affiliations and contact information, and adds acknowledgments. The main section order and most exposition remain unchanged.

P2.justification: All five figures and four tables are retained. Several displays are resized, Figure 3 moves from page 4 to page 5, and the expanded author block and other layout adjustments reflow text. No new scientific display is introduced.

improvement.justification: The added code-access pointer modestly improves reproducibility guidance, and the qualified image-fidelity statement improves precision. These benefits are limited: scientific evidence is unchanged, repository usability cannot be assessed from the PDFs, and the introduction's stronger 'inevitably learns' wording is not accompanied by new support.
